title: [GMCP 203.006.M] Mastery: Production-grade Streamable HTTP transport
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-006-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: GMCP serves and consumes current Streamable HTTP over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 with correct POST semantics, media negotiation, streaming and non-streaming responses, origin/host validation, protocol and method headers, cache controls, cancellation, backpressure, connection limits, TLS, proxy awareness, and graceful drain. Removed GET/SSE-resume/session behavior is rejected on the modern path and confined to explicit legacy adapters. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
